marker_reviews.reason: The cited verifier-owned contract asserts the durable catalog outcome of all four CREATE TABLE markers: exactly one arm's mg_combination_description, item_product_description and both history tables exist and the opposite schema's pair is absent.
The cited contract proves the audit trigger function exists in the applied arm; the migration was rehearsed locally on all three database shapes with the audit path exercised.

Inner EXECUTE inside the audit function body: runtime history-row insertion performed by the trigger, not a catalog object; no post-apply catalog probe can or should assert it. Behavior is proven by the sandbox BEGIN-ROLLBACK trigger test at apply time.

The cited contract asserts the final trigger state: the two named audit triggers and the write guard exist on exactly the applied arm's tables, which is the durable outcome of each idempotent drop-and-create pair.
The cited contract asserts all four named indexes of the applied arm exist (combination, review partial, and both run_id indexes), the durable outcome of these four CREATE INDEX markers.

The cited contract asserts the production arm grants the item-master grants role select, insert, update and delete on both live tables and insert on both history tables; the sandbox arm is owner-only by design.
